Trial stay for approved adopters. You must complete an adoption application and be approved, then rent the dog for the day ($20) or overnight ($40). The fee is credited toward adoption if you adopt. Call 940-855-4941. Shelter at 4360 Old Iowa Park Rd. Hours Mon-Fri 9:30-5:30, Sat 10-3. Also offers a paid off-site Cuddle Service for groups ($100/hr).

Request an outing Sign up on the shelter's site

Rules, hours and fees are set by the shelter and can change. Always confirm with the shelter before you go. ShelterDayOut isn't affiliated with this shelter and doesn't arrange outings.
